# VirtualFileSystem

A virtual file system (VFS): a named folder tree in a namespace. Capsules and code pipelines mount it as a directory, apps and agents read and write it, and you can fill it through the API.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The file system's name. |
| `mounts` | [`VirtualFileSystemMount`](virtual-file-system-mount.md)`[]` | The runs it is mounted into right now. A file system cannot be destroyed while it is mounted. |
| `status` | [`VirtualFileSystemStatus`](virtual-file-system-status.md) | Whether it is active or being destroyed. |
| `dateDestroyed` | `datetime \| null` | When destroying it began (UTC). Null while it is active. |
| `userCreatedById` | `uuid` | The id of the user who created it. A call made with an API key is recorded as the key's user. |
| `namespaceId` | `uuid` | The id of the namespace it belongs to. |
| `tenantId` | `uuid` | The id of the tenant it belongs to. |
| `id` | `uuid` | The unique id. Use it in `by-id` routes and wherever another object refers to this one. |
| `dateCreated` | `datetime` | When it was created, in UTC. |
| `dateUpdated` | `datetime` | When it was last changed, in UTC. |

## Where it's used

- [`vfs.create`](../api/vfs.md) (`POST /namespaces/{namespaceName}/vfs`)
- [`vfs.getByName`](../api/vfs.md) (`GET /namespaces/{namespaceName}/vfs/by-name/{name}`)
- [`vfs.get`](../api/vfs.md) (`GET /vfs/by-id/{id}`)
- [`vfs.list`](../api/vfs.md) (`GET /namespaces/{namespaceName}/vfs`)
- [`vfs.list`](../api/vfs.md) (`GET /vfs`)
